manuals.title: DeltaV Distributed Control System Reference Manual

content.title: DeltaV System Overview
content.content: DeltaV is a distributed control system for process industries. Architecture: controllers (MX, PK, SX), I/O cards (CHARMs, traditional), workstations, servers, network. DeltaV Live: HTML5 web interface. DeltaV SIS: separate safety system (SIL 3). Integrated historian, batch, advanced control. Cybersecurity: DeltaV Secure.

content.title: Controller Platform
content.content: MX Controller: high-capacity, redundancy (hot standby), 4000 I/O per pair. PK Controller: process, 1600 I/O. SX Controller: small systems, 400 I/O. All: function blocks (Control, Logic, Arithmetic, Signal Processing), sequential function charts, custom algorithms (C/C++). Deterministic scan: 100ms-1s.

content.title: CHARMs I/O
content.content: Characterization Module (CHARM): one per field device. Universal I/O: AI, AO, DI, DO, HART, pulse, RTD, TC. Electronic marshalling: software-defined wiring. HART pass-through. Intrinsically safe options. Hot-swappable. Reduces wiring by 50%. Auto-discovery.

content.title: DeltaV Live (HTML5 Interface)
content.content: Web-based operations interface. No client install. Responsive design. Graphics: SVGs, situational awareness. Faceplates: standard, custom. Alarm management: ISA-18.2. Trends, historian integration. Mobile: iOS/Android app. Authentication: Windows, LDAP, SAML. Role-based access.

content.title: DeltaV SIS (Safety Instrumented System)
content.content: Separate safety architecture. SLS 1508 controller (SIL 3). SISnet protocol (deterministic, redundant). SIF: Safety Instrumented Functions. Proof testing wizard. Bypass management. Integration with DeltaV for alarms, events, historian. Partial stroke testing. SIL verification.

content.title: DeltaV Batch
content.content: ISA-88 compliant batch management. Recipe: procedures, unit procedures, operations, phases. Equipment model: units, equipment modules, control modules. Recipe editor: graphical (SFC-based). Execution: promoter, operator prompts, electronic signatures. Material tracking. Integration with MES/ERP.

content.title: Advanced Control (MPC)
content.content: DeltaV PredictPro: Model Predictive Control. Dynamic matrix control (DMC). Constraint handling: manipulated, controlled, auxiliary. Adaptive models. Integration with DeltaV controls. Configuration: Identify, Test, Implement, Monitor. Applications: distillation, reactor, FCC, blending.

content.title: DeltaV Cybersecurity
content.content: DeltaV Secure: whitelisting, patch management, antivirus, backup, audit. Defense-in-depth: network segmentation, firewalls, DMZ. IEC 62443 compliance. User authentication: Windows, PKI, smart cards. Privilege management. Security zones. Incident response. Patch validation on test system.

content.title: Experion PKS Overview
content.content: Process Knowledge System (PKS) for process automation. Architecture: C300 controller, FIM (Fieldbus Interface Module), LIM (Local I/O Module), Server, Station (HMI), Historian. Experion Station: unified operations interface. Safety Manager: SIL 3 separate system. APC: Advanced Process Control. Uniformance: integration platform.

content.title: C300 Controller
content.content: High-performance redundant controller. 1000+ function blocks. Control: PID, cascade, ratio, override, split-range. Logic: IEC 61131-3 (FBD, LD, ST, SFC). Redundancy: hot standby <1s switchover. Peer-to-peer communication. OPC UA server. Cybersecurity: signed firmware, secure boot.

content.title: Experion Station (HMI/SCADA)
content.content: Unified operations: process, safety, batch, APC, historian. HTML5 web client (Station Web). Situational awareness graphics. Alarm management: ISA-18.2, EEMUA 191. Faceplates: standard library, custom. Trends: real-time, historical, comparison. Reports: automatic, on-demand. Mobile: Station Mobile app.

content.title: Safety Manager
content.content: Separate safety system (SIL 3). TMR (Triple Modular Redundancy) or duplex. Safety logic: FBD, LD. SIF management. Proof test wizard. Bypass/override management. Integration: Experion Station for alarms, faceplates. Fieldbus: Safety Fieldbus (Honeywell), PROFIsafe. Partial stroke testing.

content.title: Uniformance Platform
content.content: Integration platform: historian (PHD), analytics, reporting, MES connectivity. PHD: high-performance time-series. Analytics: Golden Batch, PCA, anomaly detection. Reporting: automated, web-based. Connectors: PI, SQL, OPC, REST. Pharma: 21 CFR Part 11 compliance.

content.title: CENTUM VP Overview
content.content: Integrated production control system. Architecture: FCN/FCJ (control), FCS (safety), FIO (I/O), Vnet/IP (plant network), HIS (historian), ENG (engineering station), OPS (operator station). ProSafe-RS: separate safety system. Exaopc: OPC server. Exapilot: HMI/SCADA. PRM: Plant Resource Manager (asset management).

content.title: FCN/FCJ Controllers
content.content: FCN-RTU: field controller. FCN-DCS: DCS controller. FCJ: high-performance. Function blocks: control, logic, sequence, arithmetic. Redundancy: hot standby (FCN), TMR (FCJ). Vnet/IP: dual redundant Ethernet. Scan: 100ms-1s. Online download. Capacity: 10,000 blocks (FCJ).

content.title: ProSafe-RS (Safety System)
content.content: Separate safety architecture (SIL 3). TMR controllers. Safety logic: FBD, SFC. Vnet/IP safety network. Integration with CENTUM VP: shared engineering, unified HMI. Proof testing. Bypass management. Partial stroke testing. Field devices: PROFIsafe, HART safety.

content.title: Exapilot HMI/SCADA
content.content: Web-based operator interface. Graphics: vector, situational awareness. Alarm: ISA-18.2, EEMUA 191. Faceplates: standard, custom. Trends: real-time, historical. Reports. Mobile: Exapilot Mobile. Security: Windows, LDAP, SAML. Redundancy: hot standby servers.

content.title: PRM (Plant Resource Manager)
content.content: Asset management: device configuration, diagnostics, calibration, maintenance. HART, FOUNDATION Fieldbus, PROFIBUS PA. Device DTMs. Calibration management. Maintenance scheduling. Integration with CMMS/EAM. Mobile: PRM Mobile. Cloud: PRM Cloud.
